extraction.name: CommonCatalog
extraction.description: A dataset of roughly 70 million open-licensed Creative Commons images paired with high-quality synthetic captions produced via transfer learning (telephoning) with BLIP-2, curated to train text-to-image open diffusion models (CommonCanvas).
extraction.license: Creative Commons licenses (CC-BY 2.0, CC-BY-SA 2.0, CC-BY-NC 2.0, CC-BY-NC-SA 2.0, excluding non-derivative ND licenses for training)
extraction.creator: Aaron Gokaslan, A. Feder Cooper, Jasmine Collins, Landan Seguin, Austin Jacobson, Mihir Patel, Jonathan Frankle, Cory Stephenson, Volodymyr Kuleshov
extraction.rai:dataCollection: High-resolution Creative Commons images were re-scraped from Flickr using the Flickr IDs provided in the YFCC100M dataset metadata to retrieve uncompressed, high-resolution original images (exceeding 4K), excluding non-derivative (ND) licenses for the training set.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: High-resolution Creative Commons images almost completely lacked high-quality descriptive captions or alt-text necessary for text-to-image training; only about 30% had any alt-text, which frequently consisted merely of camera metadata, image titles, or URLs.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: YFCC100M Flickr image IDs and Flickr web platform.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images were center-cropped and resized to a maximum size of 512x512 pixels solely for generating captions with BLIP-2, while keeping native resolutions for training the diffusion model. Images with non-derivative (ND) licenses were excluded from training.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Captions were synthetically generated using a pre-trained BLIP-2 OPT-2.7B model (a frozen visual encoder, learned Q-Former, and frozen LLM) using an approach termed 'telephoning', requiring about 1,120 GPU A100 hours to generate captions for the CC images.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Models, datasets, and code are released on HuggingFace and GitHub with associated data cards.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Images contain public figures, celebrities, and people/faces from Flickr uploads.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Addresses copyright and legal provenance concerns associated with web-scraped datasets (such as LAION) by utilizing fully Creative Commons licensed data, and mitigates link-rot and data poisoning vulnerabilities.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Reduced diversity of n-grams (unique trigrams) in synthetic captions compared to human text. The underlying YFCC100M data is about a decade old, leading to older image distributions compared to modern web crawls.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The trained model underperformed in several categories including faces, individual celebrities, general photography, and paintings compared to models trained on broader web-scraped data.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, evaluation, and fine-tuning of text-to-image generative models; CommonCatalog-C is suitable for commercial training contexts, while CommonCatalog-NC is intended for non-commercial contexts.
